title: Choose a structure, then limit the claim
promptMarkdown: A neutral complex ML₂X₂ contains group-10 M, neutral monodentate L, and monodentate X⁻. It is diamagnetic and gives two distinct geometric isomers. (a) Determine oxidation state, d count and CN. (b) Compare square-planar and tetrahedral elementary crystal-field predictions, including d⁸ unpaired counts, and argue which best fits both observations. (c) Derive the tetrahedral barycentre levels from degeneracies and gap Δₜ. (d) State two limits of the inference and a further structural measurement. Explain why the existence of a large formation constant would not alone establish rapid ligand exchange.
hintLadder: Ask whether tetrahedral vertices permit an adjacent/opposite distinction.
